entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I think I need to return something? I bought these spin class shoes and I'm just so lost with all the information on your website.
I can certainly help you look into a return. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
Oh, I don't know. A preference, I guess? They just... they feel wrong. I wore them once and got terrible blisters on my heels. I'm not sure if it's the shoes or if the cleats are in the wrong spot.
I'm very sorry to hear the cycling shoes are causing blisters. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Fit is incredibly important.
It is, and I'm just so overwhelmed by it all. I just want a refund. The online return page was confusing. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely take care of this for you. Let me just pull up your order. I see you received them seven days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window for apparel and shoes.
Oh, really? That's a relief. So you can process it now?

Yes. I've just initiated the return process on my end. I've sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account. Just pack the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives them, we'll issue the full refund to your original payment method.
Wow, that's so much easier. Thank you so much, Alex. I really appreciate you making that simple for me.
You're very welcome. We want to make sure you're comfortable, even if it's not with our product. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
